overview: Burbage gave the crown away with his own hands and washed off his own balm. The three leaves were the ones no public house has heard. He sent for the glass, looked, and dashed it on the boards. The glass was four shillings, the first time and the only time. No one at the table stirred. Sir Robert did not move.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Stood in the scene, and did not prompt the table.

parties.name: Richard Burbage
parties.context: Gave the crown with his own hands, and dashed the glass.

parties.name: Sir Robert Cecil
parties.context: Did not move when the glass broke.

parties.name: Sir Edward Hoby
parties.context: Had his boards dashed, and did not rise to them.
